title: RT @wccftech: A researcher buys 6TB of Anthropic Claude data dumps from a China-based LLM router and finds enough evidence of data leakage
content_md:
RT @wccftech: A researcher buys 6TB of Anthropic Claude data dumps from a China-based LLM router and finds enough evidence of data leakage. The data was accessible through a third-party LLM routing service.

via Mastodon https://arint.info/
